tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las/ spyi sdom rtsa ba'i dbang skur chen mo bklag chog tu bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal rta mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud sde bzhi drug rab 'byams yi dam lha// ma lus dkyil 'khor gcig tu yongs rdzogs pa/ dbang chen sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus byin rlabs bcud// bdag gi sgo gsum thig ler 'khyil bar mdzod// bla ma lha dang dhā ki dam can la// snying nas yid ches mi phyed dad pa'i mthus// ras chod ma yin lhag pa'i bsam pa yis// gsang ba dbye la gegs med gnang ba stsol// theg pa rim dgu'i rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi dgongs pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus pa'i gsang ba bla na med cing gnyis su ma mchis pa skor bzhi las/ gnyis pa yi dam rta mchog dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum rjes gnang ste bzhir bzhugs pa las/ 'dir 'bring po smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang bskur 'chad cing*/ de la'ang spros bcas sgrub pa chen po'i sgrom du gzhug pa'i tshul ni dkyus su lag len mi thebs pas 'dir spyi 'gro'i dbang bskur dkyus ma tsam zhig bya ba'i tshul bstan pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro sta gon/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams so// dang po la/ sa chog ni sgrub gnas rnying pa la med kyang chog pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gnas khang gtsang zhing rten dang rgyan gyi bkod pas spras pa'i gung du stegs bu la dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa bkod pa'i mdun du sman raka gtor gsum dang phyi mchod rnams bsham/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs sogs nyer mkho gzhan yang tshogs par byas la/ tshig bdun dang stag sham pa'i gsol 'debs che chung gang rung*/ brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas dkar bgegs btang/ bgegs bskrad nas brtsam bzlas pa stong tshigs kyi bar las byang chung ba mthar chags su btang la bdag gi rnal 'byor bya/

de nas slar yang mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs nas bzlas pa'i bar btang la mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lhar bsgrub bo// gnyis pa bum pa ni/ rin po che'i bum pa mgul chings sna lnga pa dri bzang gi chu dang so lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba kha rgyan gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ las bum mgul chings ljang gu can dri'i chu'i bcud ldan sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas rnams skabs 'dir tshogs par byas la dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bur bkod/ rnam bum sgrub tshul dmig gsal ma gsungs pas skabs 'dir ma byas na chad skyon med cing*/ las bum/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum pa phyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa la/ nang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ rgyan rdzogs 'od kyi klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ la snying pos bskor ba/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: ces nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzlas la/ lha 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur ces mos la bcas rnams yol bas bsgrib bo// gsum pa slob ma ni/ so shing dang dor ba'i maṇ+ḍal rigs lnga'i sku rten so sor bkram pa'am tshom bu lnga pa/ srung skud kha dog lnga pa sum bsgril 'dom gang mdud pa gsum ldan sngags btab pa/ ku sha'i phon po che chung dri bzang gi chus byugs pa sogs 'du byas la/ slob ma rnams sgor khrus bya/ rtsa sngags las sngags sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing gu gul yungs thun bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ phyag bcas bla ma'i mdun du 'khod pas/ drang nges kyi chos bshad rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'am dkyus tsam du/

rang re rnams thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams shing mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis yang dang yang du g.yengs ba las/ da lam dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i yang snying gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir snying po zhig lon par ma byas na/ phyis nas 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa rnyed mi srid cing*/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyis kyang bskal mang bsags pa'i sdig sgrib skad cig la 'joms shing thar pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog pa yin cing*/ khyad par theg pa rim pa dgu'i yang bcud dbang chen yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor 'di lta bur 'jug tu yod pa ni/ tshe rabs grangs med par tshogs chen bsags pa'i 'bras bu kho na las byung ba yin pas dad pa dang spro ba rab tu skyed la thog mar sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / phyag thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: bla ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol: dbang chen pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs kyis bzung slad phyir: lhag par gnas par mdzad du gsol: zhes lan gsum zhus pa'i rjes su bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ kye ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog khyod: dbang chen yi dam dkyil 'khor du: dbang bskur byin rlabs sgrub chen phyir: lhag par gnas pa tshul bzhin bya'o: de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru: sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis med pa'i: bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag sgo 'dir 'jug par zhu: lan gsum/ bla mas/ e ma ho: sngon sbyangs skal bar ma ldan na: 'jug par dka' la nyes dmigs che: bka' 'das 'dir 'jug phyi mar brlag: las 'phro med na phyir dengs shig:

ces bsgos pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: byang chub snying por mchis bar du: bka' bsgrub dbang zhu dam bsrung lags: bdag cag dkyil 'khor 'jug par zhu'o: lan gsum/ bla mas/ e ma ho: yi dam dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor du: 'jug spro dngos grub 'tshal ba rnams: lha dang snying po bsgrub pa yi: dam tshig gnyan po bsrung nus sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ e ma ho: bla mas gang gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub: yi dam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis: dngos grub rnam gnyis nod 'tshal gyi: dam tshig gnyan po shin tu bsrung: zhes zhu/ bla mas thal sbyar dril gsil bcas dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus dgongs: sems can sdug bsngal bsgral ba'i phyir: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyi: pho brang dgongs pa 'dus pa ru: bdag gis slob ma gzhug bgyi bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba btab pas lha tshogs rnams dgyes pas slob ma rnams ci bde bar rjes su zungs shig pa'i gnang ba thob par gyur/ de nas don dam rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo dbye bar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho: ye shes dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi ru: bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyis: yi dam lha dang zhal mjal cing: dbang chen rab 'byams bskur du gsol: bla mas brda sgo dbye ba ni/ ho: ye shes rang snang dkyil 'khor du: gnyis 'dzin ma rig sgo bcad pas: ye shes lha dang zhal ma mjal: rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo dbye: bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: rang snang dbang chen dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dngos su mjal bar mos la brda'i phyag bya ba'i rjes zlos/ hrīḥho: rang snang dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mnyam yangs mtha' bral rang snang don gyi lha: sgo gsum gnyis med mnyam pa'i rang bzhin du: dbang chen ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

na mo pu ru sha ya ho: rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la rang byung rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal yang 'bul 'tshal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /bla mas/ kye ho: bu khyod 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las: thar pa'i mgon gyur dkon mchog gsum: yid kyis dmigs te phyag 'tshol la: skyabs song sdig pa bshags par gyis: dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum la deng nas byang chub ma thob bar skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ smon 'jug don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ hrīḥho: bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la: byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu gzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon pa'i byang chub sems mchog bskyed: byang chub lam la gzud pa'i phyir: 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom: lan gsum gyis sdom pa 'bogs/ bla mas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la: hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can kun: rgyud drug lam gyi sgo bcad nas: mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phyes la: dpa' bo yang snying 'bru lnga yis: bla med mchog gi gnas su drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: sa ma ya dzaḥdza: de nas sgrib pa che chung dang/ rigs bdag gi lha brtags phyir so shing dor ba ni/ dri dang ldan cing gtsang ma'i shing sor brgyad pa rtse mo me tog gis brgyan pa 'di nyid thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du zungs la yid kyis dmod pa dang tshig 'di'i rjes zlos bcas te so shing maṇ+ḍal du 'dor ba zhu/ ho: bla mas gnang ba'i so shing 'di: yi dam gang yin lha brtag phyir: maṇ+ḍal dbus su bdag 'dor gyis:

gang yin lha la der 'bab shog: ces maṇ+ḍal rigs lnga'i tsaka li bkram pa'i steng du 'dor du gzhug /ma tshud na lan gsum bskyar la brtag go / srung ba'i skud pa rdo rje'i mdud pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings pas sgo gsum gyi bar chad srung bar mos shig /hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan srad bu 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi mdud pa ldan: g.yon gyi dpung par bcings pa yis: sgo gsum bar chad kun bsrung shog: oṃ badz+ra pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu ma ma rak+ṣa ku ru rak+ṣa swā hā: rmi lam gyi sgo nas las 'phro brtag pa'i phyir du ku sha'i chun po che chung sngas dang gdan gyi don du zungs shig / ku sha'i phon po chung ba lag g.yas dang che ba g.yon du bsnol mar gtad la/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: ku sha gtsang ma'i rtswa mchog ni: dngos grub mtshan brtags gsal bya'i phyir: khyod nyid nyal ba'i sngas gdan 'bul: khyed rang rnams do nub seng ge'i nyal stabs dang yid mos gus ldan pas rmi lam gyi mtshan ma brtag par mdzod cig /des re zhig sta gon gyi chos rnams grub pa lags/ dge rtsa sems can gyi don du bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams gyes/ gzhung du me tog 'dor ba nas sgrub lung 'bogs pa'i bar du gsungs pa ni sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin pas/ 'dir dbang rkyang tsam la skabs 'dir med du mi rung ba ma yin zhing dngos gzhi'i skabs su de dag 'byung bas kyang don 'grub pa yin no// de nas slob dpon bzhengs thal mo sbyar te sta gon gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gtso: thugs rje'i byin rlabs byang sems ldan: dgongs pa rna brgyud thugs rgyud mnga': rgyud grol byang chub lam mkhan mdzad: dus gsum bla ma sku drin can: thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol:

rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang nas: yi dam dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang: chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs lha: bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rdo rje slob dpon dbu mdzad nas: mched lcam bu slob 'gro ba rnams: mngon par sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: sang nas dkyil 'khor bri brtsams pas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang: sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: ces brjod pas sta gon gyi lha rnams bar snang du 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam la sta gon gyi chas rnams bsdu'o// rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la'ang gsum/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su 'phrul stegs la sngar sta gon byas pa'i rnam bum gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ 'bru'i snod du btags grol dar snas lcibs pa dang*/ sku tsaka yongs rdzogs/ shar du ming dbang rdor dril lhan gcig pa dang srung ma'i gtor ma dmar gtor gtso 'khor drug pa rgyan ldan/ lhor dbu rgyan dang thod pa mtshan ldan du mngar gsum dang chos sman chang dang sbyar bas bkang la dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa/ nub tu rdo rje dang rig tsaka /byang du dril bu dang shel rdo me long rma bya'i mdongs sgro /bar mtshams ci bde bar sngags byang gser ram mtshal gyis bris pa/ phyag mtshan rnams dang zhi khro'i chas kyi tsaka li/ gzhung pod dam rgyud lta bu'i glegs bam/ dung dkar/ phyag shing*/ phreng ba/ pad zhwa ber phod sogs kyi tsaka li rnams dang*/ mdun du dpal gyi gtor chen gyi g.yas g.yon sman raka /chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham bya/ rgyal mtshan ral gri sogs dkyil 'khor gyi chas ji ltar 'dzom pa dang/ sngon gtor/ chad brtan/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ gzhan yang mig dar me tog gis mtshon/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// de nas gsol 'debs nas brtsam phrin las kyi rim pa mthar chags su gtang zhing*/

blo rab kyis bdag mdun dbyer med snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi sgom bzlas bya/ rtogs pas mi chun na thog mar bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrub/ bzlas pa'i skabs mdun dkyil kyi go sar dzap khang dbye zhing spro bsdu so sor byas la dbang rdzas rnams kyang byin gyis brlabs/ khyad par bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha rnams dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ gzungs thag 'then la/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer sogs brjod cing bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mthar stong tshigs mchod bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dung chu phul bas/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ ces mos/ 1$0000250btags grol la phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs la thim par 1$0000300 mos te/ phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te/ dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rol mo bcas byin dbab/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa phul/ de nas srung ma'i gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya'o// gnyis pa bdag 'jug ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir dngos su bgrod pa'am yid kyis zhugs par dmigs la spos reng rdor dril thogs te/

kyai: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo srung chen mo bzhi: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: dad ldan slob ma smin zhing dbang bskur na: pho brang nang gzhug dkyil 'khor lha dang sprod: ces zhus pa tsam gyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi phyes shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas mjal bar mos la/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyis skad cig dran rdzogs la dbang thams cad thob par bsam/ 'bring gis dbang tshig rnams kha ton byed nas dbang rnams thob par bsam/ tha mas dbang bskur yongs rdzogs lhag chad med par rang la bdag 'jug blang bar gsungs/ de ltar slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang tshang ma rang nyid kyis len pa dgongs 'dus rnam gnyis gyi gzhung don yin kyang mi nus na tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi rtsa ba sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i rgyud don ltar rig pa'i me tog dor bas kyang dgos don 'grub bo// gang ltar/ lha tshogs yab yum rnams kyis dbang rdzogs par bstsal nas/ khyod kyis skal ldan skyes bu rnams la dbang bskur bar gyis shig: ces gnang ba byin cing dngos grub thob par gyur: ces bsam la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib/ tshogs chas/ rgyal chen gtor 'bul/ bgegs gtor/ dam chu bdud rtsi sogs 'du bya'o// gsum pa dbang dngos la'ang gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la/ phyi sgo'i las dang bgegs bskrad srung*// gsag sbyong skyabs sdom dngos grub sbyin// dam bsgrag dam 'bogs ye shes dbab// sgo dbye rigs brtag mig dbye zhing*// ngo sprad dzap dbyangs bya ba 'o// zhes don tshan bcu gsum du yod pa'i dang po sgo'i phyi rol du bya ba ni/ sgo bcad pa'i nang du lan 'debs pa po 'dug /las rdor gyis rdor dril thogs/ khrus bum dang mig dar khyer la phyi rol du phyin nas/ slob ma rnams

ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyis ldongs te ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po ma mjal ba'i mtshon byed du mig dar 'ching par mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣurban+dha bā ra mā ṇa ye hūm̐: thams cad lag pa sbrel te sgo srung khro bo chen po la zhu ba 'bul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dbyangs bcas/ kyai: sgo srung khro bo mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku: phyag na mtshon thogs bar chad dgra bgegs 'joms: skal ldan 'jug cing skal med skrod byed na: bdag cag skal ldan yin phyir nang du thongs: zhes zhus te sgo rdo rjes dal bus brdung zhing dril bu dkrol/ nang du 'khod pa pos/ hūm̐: nga ni ston pas mngags pa'i pho nya ste: pho brang sgo srung skal med dam nyams dang: bar chad dgra bgegs 'joms shing gdug pa 'dul: khyed cag su yin ci 'dod nga la smros: zhes brjod/ las rdor gyis/ lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho: bdag cag skal ldan dad pa dam tshig can: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug cing dbang zhu dngos grub rnams gnyis 'dod: khyod ni sgo yi srung ma thugs rje can: nges par bka' gsang gnyan po'i sgo 'di phyes: zhes zhus pa la/ nang nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: skal ldan las can dad pa dang ldan cing: ston pa'i bka' bsgrub dam la gnas byed na: dngos grub 'dod na the tshom log lta spongs: mos gus spro ba skyed la nang du 'dong: zhes lan byin la sgo dbye/ nang du lan 'debs pa zur du mi 'dzom na zhu ba dang lan gnyis ka las rdor kho nas phyi rol nas bya'o// gnyis pa bskrad srung ni/ sgo nang du slob ma rnams langs te 'khod/ slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar btang*/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul rol mo sogs tsham rngam dang las byang ltar bka' bsgo brjod la bgegs bskrad/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/

oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa sogs rgyal chen bzhi'i sngags sham du i daṃ ba liṃ sogs sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ zab cing rgya che sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ las byang ltar srung 'khor bsgom/ dpon slob tshang mas/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ces dbyangs su brjod la slob ma rnams gral du 'dug go /gsum pa gsag sbyong ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing longs sku'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bkrus pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mos la yi ge brgya pa gsung bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la yig brgya bzlar gzhug /slob dpon gyis tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab kyi bar du btang grub pa dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par mos shig / bzhi pa skyabs sdom la/ thog mar gdams pa'i che ba'i lo rgyus bshad cing maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mthar thug sku bzhi yongs rdzogs dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du theg dgu'i yang snying kun 'dus yi dam dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang bskur gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rta mchog rol pa man ngag gi rgyud las/ ston pa kun tu bzang po dang: yum chen kun bzang yab yum gnyis: 'khor 'das thog ma'i pha ma yin: de yi snang stong cha tsam las:

rta phag yab yum longs skur bzhengs: rigs lnga'i 'khor la dgongs pas bstan: zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das kun gyi khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum snang stong gi cha las/ rang gdangs rta phag yab yum longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ rang rtsal rig pa'i 'khor la gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs nas snang bar mdzad cing*/ khyad par yi dam dgongs 'dus rgyud lung man ngag gi chos rnams mkha' 'gro pad+ma lhung mdzad dbang gi rgyal mo dang*/ dpa' bo rig pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyis bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma dbang gi pad+ma'i rig 'dzin pa la gtod ces lung bstan nas/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod he ru ka'i 'du khang chen po'i ke'u tshang nub dbus su gter du sbas te/ da lta pad+ma lhung mdzad dang: dpa' bo rig pa'i rdo rjer gtad: khyed gnyis bka' yi bsdu ba gyis: khyod kyis ma 'ongs pad+ma'i rtser: o rgyan thor cog can gyi bu: rā tsa thod phreng zhes pa 'byung: de la brda ru ston par gyis: zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa na dbang chen he ru ka nyid 'chi med rdo rje'i sku can gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha ba zhes bya ba'i skur bzhengs te/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas dhā ki tsan+dha līs rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa'i gter sgrom dngos su phul nas bka' gtad pas glegs bam dbang gi bka' thob/ yi dam lha rta phag yab yum zhal mjal dbang bskur lung bstan pas yi dam lha'i dbang gi bka' bab/ mkha' 'gro dbang gi rgyal mo'i sku'i bkod pa las dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang gi bka' thob/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyis 'chi med rig pa'i dbang bskur skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i dbang thob pas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang gi bka' thob pa'i tshul bstan cing*/

'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gang 'dul sku'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas rgyal bstan nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad pas sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes yongs su grags shing*/ rgyud las/ des kyang ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus: gdong dmar srin po bod kyi yul: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la sogs pa: phag mo sde lnga'i sprul pa lnga: ti sgro brag ces snyan du brgyud: ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'jam dpal rnam 'phrul chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod yul mun pa'i smag rum du sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed brdal bar mdzad pa'i skabs su/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa sku dngos kyis phebs nas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa 'grub pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/ mdo sngags dam chos rgya mtsho lta bu bsgyur cing 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi rtsa ba btsugs/ lha srin gdug pa can rnams bka' 'og tu bcug cing sa rdo ri brag thams cad gnas chen du byin gyis brlabs/ bye brag gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor zab cing rgya che ba bskor nas ming can dang ming med kyi gter kha grangs las 'das pa sbas te rgyal tshab gter ston rim par 'byung ba lung du bstan/ khyad par bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung 'dus pa khro bo rta mchog rgyal po'i dgongs 'dus/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi snying khrag /ye shes dang 'jig rten kun gyi srog 'dus pa/ rtsa gsum chos srung gi tshogs rnams sprin dang char ltar 'du ba yi dam dgongs 'dus su grags pa'i rgyud lung man ngag gi skor las/ ma hā yo ga spyi khog rta mgrin gyi chos rnams bsam yas rta mgrin gling dang mchims phu rdza'i khrod du chos rgyal la gsungs/ a nu yo ga mkha' 'gro gsang lam skor ni gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas su mtsho rgyal la gnang*/ a ti rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol skor ni lho brag dung gi phug par nam mkha'i snying po la bstsal/

yang ti bla ma nor bu'i skor ni tsa ri zil chen rdo rje phug tu mtsho rgyal la gsungs/ phyis su bsam yas mchims phu dang dbu rtse'i pho brang la sogs par/ nam snying mchog dbyangs mtsho rgyal mu ne chos blo mgon po sogs rje 'bangs 'dus pa phyi ma bcu bdun la chos bka' yongs rdzogs kyi smin grol bstsal/ rgyud dkrug lung gcus man ngag gab pa rnams mngon du phyungs te rtsa ba sdong po dang 'dra ba rgyud kyi skor/ de'i 'brel yan lag gi tshul du rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus smin grol rim gnyis skor/ bkrag gsal me tog gi tshul mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus gsang lam dmar po'i skor/ snying bcud 'bras bu dang 'dra ba rdzogs chen a ti'i skor/ 'bras bu bcud du smin pa dang mtshungs pa yang ti bla ma nor bu'i skor/ shun pags lo 'dab dang 'dra ba las bzhi sna tshogs kyi skor/ gzhan dbang du mi 'gyur zhing rang dbang spyod pa'i bdag po dang 'dra ba bka' srung gsang ba spu gri'i skor te skor tsho chen po bdun du phyes/ dgos dgu ma lus tshang bas dgongs 'dus/ gang bsam yid bzhin du 'grub pas nor bu/ theg dgu rgyud bzhi rdzogs pas chen po/ tshig rgyas la lag len go bde ba don 'dus pa/ kun dang mthun zhing gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i zab chos de nyid mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sogs mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa rnams kyis shog ser rigs lngar yig rigs mi 'dra ba dgur bkod/ yig 'bru re re la'ang mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag du ma 'du bar byin gyis brlabs nas gu ru'i bka' bzhin ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi gdul bya la dgongs nas gter du sbas te/ rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro de yis lnga brgya'i dus: dur khrod sba seng nye ba'i gnas: mtha' 'khob dur khrod rta mchog gling: dga' ba 'khyil pa'i phug pa ru: tshig rgyud shog ser gter rgya brgyud: smon lam dbang bskur gter du sbos: zhes gsungs pa ltar/

sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi byang gling dur khrod chen po dga' ba tshal gyi pha waṃ phag sdig khyung gsum du sbas shing zab mo'i rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab pa nyid 'don pa'i skyes mchog ni/ ji skad du/ bod 'dir rgyal po'i ming btags brgya rtsa brgyad: gangs dang seng ge las kyis 'brel pa yis: 'jig rten pa la bde ba skad cig med: dpal gyi brag la sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas 'byung: o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa zhes bya 'byung: zhes dang*/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po sogs gter kha gsar rnying mang po nas mgrin gcig tu bsngags shing lung bstan pa/ ār+ya sa le'i skye mtha' gter ston grub thob yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba dpa' bo stag sham nus ldan rdo rje 'am/ o rgyan bsam gtan gling pas sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang chen sku rten mthong grol chen mo sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rten dang dam rdzas du ma dang bcas te spyan drangs pa'i zab chos bla na med pa 'di la smin byed dbang bskur rgyas pa spros bcas lha dbang chen mo/ 'bring po spyi sdom rtsa ba'i dbang chog /bsdus pa spros med thugs kyi dbang bskur sogs su bzhugs pa las/ 'dir spyi sdom smin byed rtsa ba'i dbang bskur bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob dpon gyis bya ba'i rim pa rnams rgyas par grub pa yin pas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul 'tshal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul du gzhug / bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dbang chen yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor la mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum po sprin 'khrigs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag sogs sems can thams cad deng nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi ba dang*/

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing de'i bslab pa la slob par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: chos sku longs sku sprul sku sogs: skyabs gnas dkon mchog thams cad la: bdag gzhan gus pas skyabs su mchi: dus 'di bzung nas snying po'i bar: 'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du: byang chub sems mchog rin po che: bskyed cing bslab pa'i don la 'jug: ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang: ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang: dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing: 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god: lan gsum/ rigs lngas bsdus pa'i dam tshig spyi dang khyad par ba rnams kyang blangs nas tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas rjes zlos/ kye hoḥrdo rje slob dpon dang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dgongs: ji ltar rdo rje 'chang sogs rnams: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams kyi: sdom pa'i tshul la gnas pa ltar: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang: dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su: ji srid rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: gtso bos ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams kyi: sdom pa ma lus bzung nas kyang: gdams ngag bslab pa'i don rnams ni: g.yel med rtag tu 'jug par bgyi: kun kyang kun bzang sa la 'god: lan gsum/ de nas byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

slob dpon gyi rlung 'byin 'jug lan gsum dang sbyar la/ bla ma'i shangs bug g.yas nas rlung gi rang bzhin oṃ dkar po 'phros/ slob ma'i sna bug g.yas su zhugs/ g.yon nas oṃ dmar po 'phros g.yon du zhugs/ gnyis ka nas hūm̐ sngon po 'phros/ sna bug gnyis su zhugs pas slob ma skad cig gis rgyu'i he ru ka rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis dri'i thig le gnas gsum du mas nas yar bkod la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ: slar yas nas mar bkod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa: mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa: thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal bas: slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje mi zad pa rol pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor gyur pa la mchod pa'i bye brag rnam pa du mas mchod par mos shig: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes sngags rgya dang dngos su bshams pas kyang mchod pa'i tshul bya/ des ni dbang bskur ba la rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa'o: skabs 'dir rgyud kyi dgongs pas so shing srung skud ku sha rnams sbyin par bshad pa ltar spro na sta gon ltar bya/ mi 'grub na gong du song bas don 'thus so// lnga pa dngos sgrub sbyin pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rin po che las grub pa'i cod pan lag du thogs par mos shig oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe bh+rūm̐: zhes cod pan gtad/ slar yang snyim par me tog thogs la dkyil 'khor bskor zhing sgo ma rnams la gus pa'i tshig gsol bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid gtso: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi:

sprul pa yang sprul bcas rnams kyis: sgo phyes thar pa'i grong bstan cing: bla med byang chub lam bgrod 'tshal: thugs rje chen pos da dgongs 'tshal: lan gsum me tog 'thor/ las rdor gyis slob dpon bzhugs pa'i yol ba yod na bsal/ de nas khyed rang rnams mos gus skyed la smin byed kyi dngos grub zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos skyong ma gtogs pa'i: skyabs dang skyob pa gzhan na ma mchis pas: khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag cag bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum/ bla mas/ e ma ho: 'dir 'dus mched lcam skal bzang rigs kyi bu: khyed rnams 'dod pa ci yod bdag gis sbyin: dam tshig bsrung sems dad pa'i shugs skyed de: the tshom som nyi med par 'dod don smros: zhes dris pa'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ni 'bras bu gsang sngags don gnyer phyir: lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol 'dod na: thugs rjes deng 'dir bdag la gnang bar mdzod: lan gsum zhu'o// drug pa dam bsgrag pa ni/ de la gsang sngags zab mo'i lta spyod ni skal med skal dman log par lta ba'i rigs la shin tu sba zhing gsang ste spyod na dngos grub 'grub pa yin pas/ dam tshig gnyan pos dgag cing gsang bar gnyer du gtad pa yin pas don thugs la nges par mdzod cig /kye ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed rnams las sad 'khrul pa zhig: rigs kyi bu mchog khyed yin pas: ngas khyod kun bzang rigs lnga yi: dal du gzhug cing ye shes dbab: dngos grub ma lus khyod kyis thob: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dag ni: ma mthong rnams la ma smra gsang: gal te ma gsang smras gyur na: dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar ltung: e ma ho: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rigs lnga ye shes rnam pa lnga:

khyed kyi snying la zhugs pa ste: 'di smras ye shes lha dang bral: ma smras gsang ba gnyer thub na: ye shes lha dang lhan cig tu: bla med don brnyes the tshom med: de phyir gang gnyer ma nyams srungs: zhes bsgo'o// bdun pa dam 'bogs pa ni/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po rim par 'bogs pa yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ ho: de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi: he ru ka dpal nga yin pas: nga yi bsgo ba'i las 'di la: khyod kyis nam yang bcag mi rung: sa ma ya i dan+tu: bdud rtsi'i dam chu blud la/ hūm̐ hrī: 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu: 'gyur med ye shes rdo rje byin: bsgos pa'i dam tshig ma nyams srungs: bsrungs na dngos grub thams cad thob: nyams na dmyal bar bsreg par bya: de phyir dam tshig ma nyams par: dam tshig rdo rje'i chu 'di thungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī a mṛta sa ma ya swā hā: slob dpon gyi thugs las ye shes sems dpa' gnyis pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar zhugs par mos shig / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtad la/ ho: khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs: ye shes sems dpar gyur nas ni: myur du gsang sngags dngos grub thob: gal te dam tshig las 'da' na: lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgur gyur: khyod kyi snying khrag 'thung nas ni: de ma thag tu dral te gshegs: rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshod par 'gyur: tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+tu: 'o skal ldan khyod kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsa gsum dang bcas pa yin pas: ston pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin du: rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis kyang khyed rnams la dam tshig gi bka' phog pa 'di la ma 'da' zhig: gal te 'das na myur du rdo rje dmyal bar ltung nas thar ba'i dus med par 'gyur ro: zhes dang rgyas par spro na dam tshig gi rnam bshad bya'o// brgyad pa ye shes dbab pa ni/

da ni smin byed kyi gzhi'am rtsa bar gyur pa ye shes pa rgyud la dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdud rtsi sbyin/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pa'i ngang*/ ngag gnad srog rtsol steng 'og kha sbyor du chings la/ sems kyi gnad yid gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di dag rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pad+ma nyi ma zla ba bam ro'i gdan gyi steng du/ ye nas ma bcos rdzogs pa'i dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar la rngam pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po rngam zhing bzhad pa/ shar gyi zhal dkar la zhi ba/ lho zhal ser la 'tsher ba/ nub zhal mthing nag 'bar ba/ byang zhal ljang nag khros pa dbu la rta dbu lnga dang ldan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan cing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ smar smin me ltar 'bar zhing dbu skra sprin ltar gtibs pa la thod rlon sbrul dkar gyis dpral bar bcings pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa brgyad kyis rdo rje rtse dgu /rtse lnga/ lcags kyu/ ral gri /mkha' lding*/ gsal shing*/ me dpung*/ zhing snying 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis thod khrag /chu skyes/ tshe'i ga'u/ gshol mda'/ sbrul zhags/ dbang gi phyag rgya/ gser gyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa/ zhabs brgyad 'dor thabs su bgrad pas lha chen tshogs bdag brdzis pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon du gdengs pa las gnas dang yul gyi ma mo brgyad dang*/ nor bu 'bar ba'i thel chung las nor bdag brgyad 'gyed pa/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal sogs dur khrod kyi chas brgyad/ dpal gyi chas dgu dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo mthing nag gri gug thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khril ba/ sku la dur khrod rus pa'i chas du mas brgyan cing spyi bor phag zhal ngur ba/

bde stong dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru yid bzhin nor bu dmar gsal rdor dril bsnams pas yum mtsho rgyal dkar mo nor bu dang thod pa bsnams pa la 'khyud pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas dang ldan pa rang 'od me dpung 'ja' zer thig le'i klong na bzhugs par mos mdzod/ de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams dang bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas ye shes sems dpa' rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byin thibs se byon nas/ dkyil 'khor lha dang dbang gi rdzas khyed rang rnams la rgya mtsho chen por kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim par mos shig / ces brjod la dzap dbyangs lan gsum bya/ gu gul dkar nag bsreg /rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings ka dag spros bral zhing khams nas: sku gsum dgongs brgyud bla mas byin phob cig: rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub pho brang nas: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla mas byin phob cig: gang 'dul der snang sprul pa'i gnas mchog nas: snyan brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: dbang chen me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: yi dam rta phag yab yum byin phob cig: rgya gar bal bod za byed srin yul nas: o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng byin phob cig: gsang sngags chos kun 'byung gnas yum chen mo: ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: bod yul gangs can dag pa'i gnas mchog nas: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin rgya mtshos byin= gter gnas dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: rtsa gsum yi dam dgongs 'dus byin= 'gro 'dul smin grol mthar phyin pho brang nas: stag sham nus ldan rdo rjes byin=

zab gter chos sgo du mas 'gro ba 'dren: brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams kyis byin= bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gsum ldan pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can rgya mtshos byin= sku yi byin rlabs gzi byin lams se lam: lus la bde drod skyed pa'i byin phob cig: gsung gi byin rlabs sngags sgra 'u ru ru: ngag la nus pa 'bar bar byin= thugs kyi byin rlabs nyams rtogs sha ra ra: sems la rtogs pa 'char bar byin= gzugs snang lha ru gsal ba'i byin= sgra grags sngags su 'char ba'i byin= gang shar chos skur rtogs pa'i byin= snod bcud dag pa rab 'byams byin= sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus paḥ 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan rgyud la byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: ā be sha ya a ā: zhes pa'i dzap dbyangs lan gsum brjod/ slar yang spogs pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gi nang du g.yung drung 'khyil pa dmar po'i lte bar: zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du yaṃ gyis mtshan pa: g.yung drung gi rwa bzhi la ha ri ni sa bzhi bskyed: yaṃ las rlung gis bskyod pas: g.yung drung sngags dang bcas pa g.yon du kyi li li 'khor ba: de las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs lnga la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thibs thibs byon cing khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim par mos shig: 'beb pa'i rdzas sbyor bsreg /rol mo drag tu 'khrol la/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ ā be sha ya: s+t+waṃ bha ya: ra rā: ra rā: tsā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a dzhaiṃ: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ: pheṃ pheṃ: zhes brjod la me tog gtor bas byin phebs pa'i rtags lus ngag yid gsum la 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de ltar phab pa'i ye shes pa de nyid byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rdor dril gnas gsum du reg /'bru 'thor la rtsa sngags sham bur/ dzñā na satwa tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes brtan par bya'o// dgu pa sgo dbye ba ni/ brda'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi nas rim gyis phyag 'tshal zhing sgo dbye bar gsol ba gdab pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: shar gyi phyogs na bzhugs pa yi: sgo srung rdo rje lcags kyu ma: shar gyi phyogs kyi sgo phyes la: bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod: kye: lho yi phyogs na bzhugs pa yi: sgo srung rin chen zhags pa ma: lho yi phyogs kyi sgo phyes la: bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod: kye: nub kyi phyogs na bzhugs pa yi: sgo srung pad+ma lcags sgrog ma: nub kyi phyogs kyi sgo phyes la: bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod: kye: byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa yi: sgo srung karma dril bu ma: byang gi phyogs kyi sgo phyes la: bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod: ces gsol ba btab pas phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi rang rang gis de ma thag phyes nas rang snang ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mjal bar mos shig / yol ba bsal/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang du ltos la kha dog gi mtshan ma ji ltar mthong ba smros shig / ces dris la/ kha dog sna lnga gang mthong ba de'i rigs dang mthun pa'i phrin las 'grub par lung bstan pa yin no// bcu pa rigs brtag pa ni/ sngar byin pa'i me tog con pan thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du zungs la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ e ma ho: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: lha dang 'brel phyir me tog 'dor bgyid na: ston pas bkal stsol thugs rjes gsang sgo phyes: gang la 'brel yod de la sprad par 'tshal: slob dpon gyis/ e ma ho: rigs dang ldan pa'i skyes mchog rnams: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho sgo nas: las kyi rdo rjes bsgos pa bzhin: smon lam thob la cod pan dor: ces gnang ba sbyin/ me tog dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs nas dbus su dor te rigs dang 'brel pa'i lhag pa'i lha la phog par gyur cig pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos/

e ma ho: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: me tog cod pan 'di dor bas: sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha: gang yin de la bab par shog: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya pra tīts+tsha ku su mañdza ye nā tha ho: zhes dkyil 'khor dngos sam 'grim dkyil du 'dor gzhug la/ dbus su babs na/ 1$0000250dbang chen rigs 'dus rtsal 1$0000300 lam/ 1$0000250yongs rdzogs lhun grub rtsal 1$0000300 sogs dang*/ shar du/ 1$0000250dbang chen mi bskyod 1$0000300 dam/ 1$0000250mi 'gyur rtsal/ 1$0000300 des mtshon nas/ lhor 1$0000250yon tan 1$0000300 dang*/ 1$0000250'dod 'byung*/ 1$0000300 nub tu 1$0000250bde mchog 1$0000300 dang*/ 1$0000250dgyes mdzad/ 1$0000300 byang du 1$0000250drag po 1$0000300 dang*/ 1$0000250las grub/ 1$0000300 mtshams rnams su/ 1$0000250zhi byed/ bde rgyas/ smin grol/ sna tshogs rtsal 1$0000300 sogs su gdags par gsungs so// me tog phog pa'i rigs kyi lha yang dkyil 'khor gyi khyab bdag dbang chen he ru ka'i rang rtsal las byung bas rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pas/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur ba yin pas dbang rtags su lhag pa'i lhas me tog gi cod pan slar yang spyi bor bcings par mos shig /

cod pan so so'i spyi bor bzhag la/ hrī: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: me tog phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis: sku gsung thugs su bstims nas kyang: dngos grub khyod la sbyin par bya: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pra ti gṛh+ṇa ho: ma hā bā la hūm̐: bcu gcig pa mig dbye ba ni/ bla mas gser thur thogs la/ thugs rje ye shes kyi 'od zer thur ma lta bus khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig rmongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyi ling tog bsal nas/ mkhyen gnyis ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par mos shig hrīḥho: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis: khyod kyi ma rig 'khor ba'i mig: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya: de bzhin nyon mongs 'gro ba rnams: ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog: oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: ces mig dar bsal lo// bcu gnyis pa ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar ye shes dag pa'i spyan thob pa la mthong ba bstan pa yin pas/ ho: skal ldan rnams legs par gsan 'tshal: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di yang: tha mal gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i pho brang chen po rgya chad phyogs lhung med par: mnyam yangs zang thal rang byung 'od gsal ye shes ma sgrib rang shar snang ba'i gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka yum gzi ldan pad+ma dang bde stong gnyis su med pa'i rol pa las sprul pa'i sgrol yum e ka khros ma: thabs shes byi la pu shud mgo can dang: sku yi sprul pa gar dbang yab yum mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi: gsung sprul nag po klu 'dul: thugs kyi sprul pa ye shes khro bcu yab yum za gsod khra thabs nyi shu: sprul pa ma mo brgyad dang phra men brgyad sgo ma bzhi dbang phyug nyer brgyad bse'i lha mo bzhi: bka' dang bstan pa srung ba'i phyogs skyong bcu:

dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po bzhi: yang sprul bka' sdod pho nya dmus long khyi spyang 'byung bzhi 'brug chen: dus 'dzin ti ra gnas nyul gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum du mjal snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod: mdor na rten dang brten par shar ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa thams cad: bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang chen pad+ma he ru kā'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba yin pas de ltar ngo shes par mdzod cig: de ltar gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di rnams mthong ba dang thos pa dang dbang bskur thob pa tsam gyis byin rlabs kyi bden pas: 'di nas skye ba bdun tshun chad la ma bsgom yang sangs rgya bar 'gyur bas dga' ba dang spro ba skyed 'tshal: zhes ngo sprad la dbugs dbyung*/ bcu gsum pa dzap dbyangs bya ba ni/ brda'i 'bul len sngon du 'gro bas las rdor gyis slob dpon nas brtsam ste tshogs kyi bza' btung drang zhing rtsa sngags la dzap dbyangs gang 'grub bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la gzhung las bla ma dgongs 'dus don dbang dang mtshungs par sa bcad bdun du gsungs kyang sa bcad phyi ma gsum snga ma bzhi'i khongs su 'du zhing*/ dbang dngos sa bcad bzhi la nang gses kyi dbye ba dang bcas pas bstan par mdzad pas/ de ltar na rnam grangs bzhi ste/ spros bcas bum dbang*/ spros med gsang dbang*/ rab tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ shin tu spros med dbang bzhi pa'o// dang po la gsum/ phyi bum pa'i dbang*/ nang rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang*/ gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de yi dang po bum dbang la'ang gnyis/ gsol gdab dang*/ dbang dngos so// dang po ni/ de dag rnams kyi sgo nas mtshan ma rdzas dang don dam ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa grub pa yin zhing*/

dngos gzhi'i dbang la bum gsang sher ye dbang bzhi pa rnams kyis bsdus pa las/ thog mar bum pa'i dbang la'ang phyi nang gsang ba gsum du yod pa'i dang po la dngos dang mtha' rten gnyis las/ dngos gzhi'i rig pa'i dbang lnga zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ e ma ho: gtso bo ston pa rdo rje rgyal po dang: rgyal tshab rgyal thebs gzungs mar bcas pa dang: bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: gsang sngags snying po bcud kyi mthar thug mchog: smin byed rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ gnyis pa dbang dngos la gnyis// rig pa'i dbang lnga/ mtha' rten no// dang po dbang lnga'i thog ma chu dbang ni/ las rdor gyis rnam bum btegs/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las: mi bskyod yab yum sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: dbang bskur ba tsam gyis bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du: bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa yab yum ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin la: 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dang: gzhan yang sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: rigs kyi lha mo brgyad: 'khor gyi sems dpa' bcu drug: sems ma bcu drug: khro bo bcu: mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug la sogs pa rnams kyis bskor cing byung nas: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros dbang bskur: 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug gis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod: rig ma bcu drug gis rdo rje'i glu blang: khro bo bcus bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad: mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs par bsam nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/

hūm̐ hrī: bum pa chos dbyings dag pa'i gzhal yas khang: bdud rtsi yid bzhin rgya mtshor 'khyil pa yi: bcom ldan mi bskyod yab yum dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la bskur bar bya: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha bo dhi satwa ha ya grī ba gu ru dhe wā dhā ki nī badz+ra ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: badz+ra satwa hūm̐: zhes bskur la bum chu blud/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad rkyal grod 'o mas gang ba bzhin du dang mer gyis gang: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim: des mi bskyod pa bum pa'i dbang thob: nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi sgrib pa dag: rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur: me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas te: rdo rje rigs kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o: gnyis pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/ dbu rgyan btegs la/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas cod pan stong pa'i ngang las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las: rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa: dbang bskur ba tsam gyis dbu rgyan gzhal yas khang gi nang du: bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ye shes sems dpa'i sogs gong ltar brjod pa 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gres te/ dbu rgyan mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: khams gsum re 'dod skong ba'i rgyal po che: yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gter gyi mchog: dbu rgyan dar dpyang ldan pas dbang bskur ro: 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ na maḥ sogs sngags gong ltar la/ dhā ki nī rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu kuṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: su ra te s+t+waṃ: a haṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ya ho: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: zhes dbang bskur ba tsam gyis slob ma'i rgyud yon tan rin po ches gang nas sangs rgyas rigs rnam pa lngas dbu brgyan par gyur:

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim: des rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas dbu rgyan cod pan gyi dbang thob: nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag: tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas: rin chen rigs kyi sa bon rgyud la thebs pa'o: gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje btegs la/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las: snang ba mtha' yas yab yum sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa: dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rdo rje gzhal yas khang gi nang du: bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas yab yum ye shes sems dpa'i sogs dang*/ rdo rje mgo dang lte bar bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi: phyag mtshan dbang 'di deng khyod bskur byas pas: 'di de sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gyur med rdo rje rab tu 'grub phyir zungs: sngags sham du/ pad+ma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma dhā ra hrī: zhes dbang bskur ba tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi nus pa thams cad la dbang thob par mos shig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim: des snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob: nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag: 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas: pad+ma rigs kyi sa bon rgyud la thebs pa'o: bzhi pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ las rdor gyis btegs la/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las ral gri āḥs mtshan pa las: don yod grub pa yab yum sku mdog ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram dang dril bu bsnams pa: dbang bskur ba tsam gyis dril bu gzhal yas khang gi nang du: bcom ldan 'das don yong grub pa yab yum ye shes sems dpa'i sogs dang*/ dril bu mgo dang gsang gnas su dkrol cing bzhag la/

hūm̐ hrī: don dam chos nyid stong pa'i sgra: gsung dbyangs drug cur mtshon pa yi: dril bu'i dbang mchog dam pa 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur bar bya: sngags sham du/ karma ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: a mo gha sid+dhi ā: zhes dbang bskur ba tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las la thogs pa med pa'i dbang thob par mos shig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim: des don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob: nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag: 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas: las kyi rigs kyi bag chags sa bon dang bcas pa rgyud la bzhag pa'o: lnga pa ming dbang ni/ rdor dril btegs la/ slob ma dbang rdzas rdor dril stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las: rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu bsnams pa: dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rdor dril gzhal yas khang gi nang du: bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad yab yum ye shes sems dpa'i sogs brjod/ rdor dril mgo bor dkrol la/ hūm̐ hrī: rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che: ming btags bdud las rnam par rgyal: ming gi dbang bskur chen mo 'di: skal ldan khyod la sbyin par bya: sngags sham du/ bud+dha nām a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: oṃ āḥbadz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bai ro tsa na oṃ: gsang mtshan ming gi byang bu gtad pa'am sngon gyi gsang mtshan yod na bos te/ oṃ rdo rje che ge khyod nyid: dag cing gsal ba'i rang bzhin te: skyon bral sems nyid rin po che: ye shes rnam pa lnga ldan gyis: srid pa gsum la dbang bskur shog: ces dbang bskur ba tsam gyis: sangs rgyas thams cad nye bar dgongs shing: srid pa gsum gyi 'ching ba las rnam par grol te: sku gsum ye shes yongs su rdzogs par mos shig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la thim:

de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob: nyon mongs pa gti mug dag: gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur: chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas: de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa rgyud la bzhag pa'o: gnyis pa mtha' rten ni/ mtha' rten rdo rje dbyings kyi lha dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kye: rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs dkyil 'khor lha: thugs rjes yongs bzung rig pa'i dbang lnga gnang: slad kyang mtha' rten byin rlabs rjes gnang ni: brtse bas deng 'dir bdag la gnang du gsol: rigs lnga'i sku rten gnas lngar bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku: rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i: de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams dang: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung: snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i: gsung mchog pad+ma'i rigs rnams dang: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs: rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i: thugs mchog rdo rje'i rigs rnams dang: sangs rgyas yon tan dgos 'dod 'byung: rin chen 'byung ldan la sogs pa'i: yon tan rin chen rigs rnams dang: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag: don yod grub pa la sogs pa'i: mngon spyod phrin las rigs rnams kyis: skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: rigs rnams ma lus yongs rdzogs shing: 'gro don kun spyod dbang thob shog: ā+oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: bai ro tsa na oṃ: pad+ma dha ra hrī: badz+ra satwa hūm̐: rat+na saṃ bha ba trāṃ: a mo gha sid+dhi ā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes skal ldan khyod la sangs rgyas sku lnga yab yum gnas lngar gtad de dbang bskur pa la brten nas: sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig: bum pas dbang bskur la/ hūm̐ḥ bum pa rnam dag chos kyi dbyings:

khams gsum pa yis phyag byas te: gsang ba gsum nas byung ba yi: gnas su sbyin nas dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye ā+oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas zhi lha gtso 'khor rnams kyi tsaka li rim par thogs la/ hūm̐: shar nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: sems dpa' kun bzang yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐: lā s+ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: lho nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: sems dpa' 'jam dpal yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ mañdzu shrī ku mā ra hūm̐: trāṃ mā l+ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: nub nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs yab yum: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ hrīḥha hūm̐ pad+ma bha ta ma hūm̐: hrīḥgīrti rā ga ya ho haṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: byang nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: sems dpa' phyag rdor yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ dz+riṃ ku ru pā ṇi hrīḥhūm̐: a nṛ t+ye rā ga ya mi s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: shar lho mtshams nas rang byung lha: sems dpa' sa snying yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog:

oṃ k+ṣi hi rā tsā ya hūm̐: dzaḥpuṣ+pe pra be sha ya s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: lho nub mtshams nas rang byung lha: sems dpa' nam snying yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ trāṃ ā gar+bha ya hūm̐: hūm̐ dhū pe ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: nub byang mtshams nas rang byung lha: sems dpa' byams pa yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ me tri dhā ra ṇi hūm̐: baṃ dhī paṃ su ki ni s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: byang shar mtshams nas rang byung lha: sems dpa' sgrib sel yab yum dang: sras 'khor sprul pa'i gtso 'khor bcus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ 1$0000290thiṃlha 1$0000300pa raṃ pa ya swā hā: hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta ya s+t+waṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: 'gro don lhun gyis grub pa'i lha: rigs drug don mdzad thub drug gis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: chags bral 'gro don byed par shog: oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne breṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne truṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne ye swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir rang byung grub pa'i lha: sgo ba ta kṛta khro bo yab yum brgyad: tshad med bzhi yi phrin las grub pa'i lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: lha dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur nas ni: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro don 'grub gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐:
