zhes bskur/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa rnam dag sogs gong ltar bskur/ ho: skal ldan khyod la sems dpa' brgyad 'khor dang bcas pas dbang bskur pas: rnam shes tshogs brgyad khams dang skye mched gnas su dag nas: zag med bde ba chen por sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: thub pa drug gi dbang bskur pas nyon mongs pa drug dag: sgo ba bzhi'i dbang bskur pas phrin las bzhi 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes me tog 'thor bar bya'o// gnyis pa nang rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang la/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga las// dang po ni/ de nas nang rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye hoḥston pa rdo rje 'dzin: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la: rdo rje rgyal po bka' yi dbang: rab 'byams yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ de nas thog mar dbang chen yab yum sras bcas kyi sku mgo la bzhag ste/ hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das: rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po yab yum dang: sgrol yum sras dang sras mor bcas pa yi: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: lha dang gnyis med gyur nas dbang thob ste: chags bral 'gro don lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: bh+yo di ma da ri e ka tsā ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: khro bcu yab yum sras bcas thogs la/ hūm̐ hrī: phyogs skyong bcu yi gdon 'dul khro bo bcu: yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas: rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas dag pha rol phyin: ye shes khro bo bcu yi dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: ke'u rī ma brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod brgyad gnas khro mo chen mo brgyad:

tshogs brgyad gnas dag lha mo'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kyang: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don 'grub gyur cig: ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: phra men brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐ hrī: mchod rten brgyad gnas phra men chen mo brgyad: siṃ ha la sogs gnas bdag dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kyang: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don 'grub gyur cig: he he he he he he he he: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: sgo ma bzhi thogs la/ hūm̐ hrī: tshad med bzhi yi phyag rgya bzhi bsgyur ma: ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kyang: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don 'grub gyur cig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: dbang phyug nyer brgyad bdun tshan rim bzhin thogs la/ hūm̐ hrī: zhi ba'i las mdzad shar gyi ma mo bdun: 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzad pa'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su= phrin las rnam bzhis= bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: rgyas pa'i las mdzad lho phyogs ma mo bdun: 'byor drug rgyas par mdzad pa'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su= phrin las rnam bzhis= bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: dbang gi las mdzad nub phyogs ma mo bdun: khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su= phrin las rnam bzhis= bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: drag po'i las mdzad byang phyogs ma mo bdun: mngon spyod las rnams 'grub pa'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su= phrin las rnam bzhis= bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: sring mo bzhi thogs la/ hūm̐ bh+yo dza: dmar mo gar mkhan dbang gi rgyal mo bzhi: sbyor sgrol gnas su dag pa'i dbang bskur bas: lha dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kyang:

phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don 'grub gyur cig: hrīng hrīng dza dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: zhes bskur/ de nas bum pa'i dbang*/ hūm̐: bum pa rnam dag sogs gong ltar bskur/ de ltar dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur pas: gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor de kho na nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro: de nas rtsa gsum spyi'i dbang ni/ bla ma sku gsum gyi sku mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: bde ba chen po bla ma chos kyi sku: gsal mdangs chen po bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs 'dzin grol bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rigs 'dus bla ma'i dbang bskur ro: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob nas: 'gro don smin grol mtha' ru phyin par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba sid+dhi dharma kā ya nirma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: bum dbang sngar ltar bskur/ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la bla ma sku gsum gyi dbang bskur pas: sku gsum lhun grub chen po'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor bcu drug mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: 'gro drug kun la thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: 'khor ba dong sprugs rigs drug 'dren mdzad pa'i: thugs rje chen po yab yum sras 'khor bcas: sems dpa' ye shes lha yi dbang bskur ro: byams dang snying rje byang chub sems thob nas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dharma dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: a tri nṛ su pre du: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: bum dbang gong bzhin/ de ltar 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur pas: byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan par 'gyur ro: kun bzang yab yum la thig le bzhi bcus bskor ba thugs kar gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: kun bzang yab yum chos dbyings mkha': zhi ba longs spyod tshom bur shar:

bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lu gu rgyud: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: chos dbyings sbubs su sangs rgyas shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: khrag 'thung yab yum bcu dpral ba sogs su bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan bud+dha he ru ka: yab yum sku lnga longs spyod rdzogs: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung: khrag 'thung bcu yi dbang bskur ro: dug lnga gnas su dag gyur cig: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: bum dbang gong ltar/ ho: khyod la yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur pas: dug lnga gnas su dag nas ye shes lnga lhun grub chen po'i dbang dang ldan par 'gyur ro: rta phag yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba lte bar gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: rta phag yab yum mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug tshogs: he ru ka dpal gar gyi rgyal po la: rigs lnga nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur bas: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi dbang thob shog: hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa dharma sid+dhi pha la sdus sdus: tsit+ta hrīng hrīng dza dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: gsang ba ye shes sku gsum phag mo phyi nang gsang ba dang bcas pa'i sku'am thig le gsang bar gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: phag mo sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso: gsang ba ye shes dbyings kyi ngang: dkar dmar mthing ba'i rang bzhin la: 'du 'bral med pa'i dbang bskur bas: phrin las thogs med 'grub gyur cig: oṃ dhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī a ha ri ni sa bā ra hi kro tī kā lī ā be sha ya sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: bum dbang gong bzhin/ ho: de ltar mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi dbang bskur pas: phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro: de nas bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dbang ni/ sku tsag rnams rim par lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī:

phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i mthu dang ldan: sangs rgyas bstan srung bcu yi dbang bskur bas: phyogs 'dzin gnas su dag pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a tri hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: las smon stobs kyis dregs pa'i ngar ldan pa: lha chen brgyad kyi dbang mchog bskur ba yis: bsod nams stobs dang ldan pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: las smon mthu stobs dregs pa'i ngar dang ldan: klu chen brgyad kyi dbang mchog bskur ba yis: mi zad nor dang ldan pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ phu phu phu phu: phu phu phu phu: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: las smon mthu stobs dregs pa'i ngar dang ldan: gza' chen brgyad kyi dbang mchog bskur ba yis: mngon spyod las la thogs med 'grub par shog: oṃ ra ra ra ra: ra ra ra ra: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: las smon mthu las dregs pa'i ngar ldan pa: rnam sras nor bdag brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: 'dod dgu'i nor mchog 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ: dzaṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ dzaṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: las smon mthu las dregs pa'i ngar dang ldan: gza' chen klu dang bdud dang re ma ti: dregs pa sde brgyad bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas: mthu nus sngags kyi dngos grub thob par shog: oṃ rā hu la phu nā ga du ru dra ma bh+yo ma ma rag mo a ya ma du ru tsa sha na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: srung ma'i gtor ma gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: khams gsum bdag po rnams kyis phyag byed pa: stong gsum dregs pa'i tshogs kyi mthu ma lus: dbang chen bstan pa bsrung phyir khyod la sbyin: nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog:

ces brjod la gtor mar sman raka bran pa'i zham chu'ang sbyin no/ gnyis pa gsung ni/ sngags byang hrīḥl dpa' bo 'bru lnga/ dpa' mo 'bru lnga/ rtsa bsnyen/ nye bsnyen/ rigs bzhi'i sngags ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po rnams kyis bskor ba gser ram mtshal gyis bris pa thogs la/ sngags kyi byang bur bris pa dang 'dra ba'i yi ge rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phog /sku gsung thugs las yig 'bru'i 'od zer slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas/ slob ma lhar gyur pa'i thugs srog hrīḥl 'dus par mos pa dang*/ rak+sha'i phreng ba gdong lnga pa rta mgrin rta dbu lnga par dmigs la 'dren bzhin du sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod byas la sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid/ gzungs ring thung rnams tshar gsum gsum re brjod/ de tsam mi nus pa'am mi shes na rtsa ba'i snying po kho nas kyang rung*/ mthar sngags byang spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: snying po sngags kyi 'bru dang bcas: thabs shes ā li kā li'i sgra: gnyis med rten 'brel snying po'i sngags: rang byung yig 'bru'i dbang bskur bas: sngags la brtan pa thob nas kyang: skye med rdo rje mngon gyur cing: phrin las thogs med 'grub par shog: oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ bh+yo di ma da ri e ka tsā ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: 'di la brten nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang bcas pa'i rgyal ba yongs rdzogs thams cad kyi: gsung gi snying po'i lung la spyod cing: las la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: de lta bu'i tshul gyis dbang bskur pas: rtsa ba gsum dang dbang chen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sngags bzlas pa la dbang zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis brnyes: nus pa'i stobs rgyas 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:

dbang chen mchog gi ye shes su brnyes par 'gyur ro: gsum pa thugs ni/ phyag mtshan rnams kyi tsaka li gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: ye shes 'khor lo rgyun chad med: chos nyid rdo rje 'gyur ba med: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung: pad+ma chags bral dri ma med: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med rgyal: chos dbyangs tshangs pa'i gaṇ+ḍi sgrog: bhan+dha bdud rtsi bcud dang ldan: phur pas bar chad dgra bgegs 'joms: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: lcags kyus snang ba dbang du sdud: zhags pas nyon mongs 'ching bar byed: lcags sgrog 'byung po'i yan lag bcing: ral gri 'bar bas bdud bzhi 'dul: bam dbyug skye shi rtsad nas gcod: khyung khras dug lnga'i sems can 'dul: cang te'u rtog bral chos sgra sgrog: thugs rje yid bzhin phyag mtshan te: skye med chos sku'i don mtshon cing: skyes mchog bu la dbang bskur bas: kun bzang dgongs pa'i don rtogs shing: 'gro ba smin grol mchog thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sarba dharmā a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: ho: skyes bu khyod la thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur pa la brten nas: dgos 'dod re ba yid bzhin du bskangs nas skye med rab 'byams chos sku'i don ma nor bar mngon du rtogs shing khong du chud pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: des ni bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la sogs rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon cing: 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro: bzhi pa yon tan ni/ rus rgyan thod phreng gos gsum rtags gsum dar dpyang sogs gnas so sor gtod tshul byas la/ hūm̐ hrī: pha rol phyin drug rtags kyi rgyan: rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang grol chas: dgos 'dod char 'beb rin po che: phrin las 'gro 'dul dar dpyang mdzes: yon tan kun 'byung rgyan gyi dbang: skyes bu khyod la bskur ba yis: sangs rgyas yon tan rab bsgrub cing: thogs med 'gro don spyod par shog:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī rat+na sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: skal ldan khyod la yon tan rin po che 'dod 'byung rgyan gyi rgyal pos dbang bskur pas: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rin po che gter gyi mdzod 'dzin cing sems can thams cad la dgos 'dod re ba yid bzhin du bskangs nas 'gro don chags thogs med par 'byung ba la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: des rgyal ba thams cad kyi longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol pa la dbang 'byor zhing: 'bras bu mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i sku thob par 'gyur ro: lnga pa phrin las ni/ 'byor na slob ma khri la bzhag /dbang zhwa dang dbang gos bskon/ lag g.yas su dung dkar/ g.yon du rgyud dam gzhung gi glegs bam/ mdun du rdor dril dang phreng ba bum pa gtor mchod sogs nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyi chas rnams gtad/ ma 'byor na ri mor bris pa sogs ji ltar rigs pa gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa dang: bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la mnga' brnyes shing: thos bsam sgom gsum phrin las thogs med pa: rang gzhan don spyod dbang 'di bskur byas pas: rgyal ba yongs kyi phrin las sgrub la brtson: 'gro don phyogs med spyod pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba karma dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: skyes bu khyod la phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang bskur pas: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las bsgrub cing: 'gro ba'i don skyo dub med par spyod pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las bsgrub pas 'gro ba'i don phyogs med du spyod pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu mngon par byang chub pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro: de ltar rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang lnga 'di thob nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i chos thams cad la nyams su len cing dbang 'byor ba'i skal pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro:

gsum pa gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ rang don sangs rgyas kun bzang mngon gyur gyi dbang dang*/ gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don sbyor gyi dbang ngo*// dang po ni/ de nas gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye hoḥston pa dgongs su gsol: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon bka' yi dbang: brtse bas bdag la bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ gdan dang dbang zhwa sogs gong ltar bya/ lag tu rdor dril gtad la/ slob ma rnams kun tu bzang po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: sku mdog rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur: bla ma'i rtogs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad slob ma'i rgyud la 'phos par mos shig: hūm̐ hrī: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i: snang stong rdo rje dril bu 'di: dbyer med rtag tu 'di zungs la: stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yis: kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis: 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin par gyis: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: dharma dhā tu dzñā na gar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: 'o skal ldan skyes bu khyod la rdo rje dril bu gtad cing: kun tu bzang por che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis: rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa non nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa klong yangs rab 'byams rang rtsal rig pa'i dbang thob pa yin no: rang sems skye ba med pa 'di chos kyi skur sangs rgyas pa yin pas: 'di ltar gyi snang ba thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'grub par 'gyur ro: gnyis pa gzhan don 'gro ba'i don dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams: phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus:

rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang rnams rab tu brtan nas kyang: snang srid gzhal yas khang gi nang: phung po khams dang skye mched rnams: lha dang lha mor lhun gyis grub: thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las kyis: 'gro don thogs pa med par spyod: phyag rgya rol pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba dharmā sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐: bh+yo di ma da ri e ka tsā ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: dharma kā ya: nirma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: sarba dharma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: 'o skal ldan skyes bu khyod la rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis bcud 'dus dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa'i bum pa 'di'i dbang bskur pa tsam gyis: phyi nang snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang lha'i rang bzhin: phung khams dang skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor gyur pa yin pas: de ltar ye nas yin pa shes par gyis la: phyi nang thams cad la brnyas par ma byed: dag snang dang mos pa rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod bkur sti rgya chen po gyis: sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pas: dang du blangs shing bsgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig: ces bum chus khrus bya zhing btung du gzhug la/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang nas de nyid kyi ye shes skyes par mos shig: ye dhar dang bkra shis brjod cing 'bru 'thor la rol mo bya/ de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur pas rang gzhan gnyis kyi don mthar phyin par 'gyur ba la dbang 'byor ba'o: de rnams kyi sgo nas phyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du spros bcas bum pa'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob:

lus kyi sgrib pa dag: bskyed rim lha sgom pa la dbang: sa brgyad pa man chad non: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub: 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: zhes rtogs pa brjod do// rtsa ba'i gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ gnyis pa nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas spros med gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dngos su ci 'byor pa dang yid sprul dpag tu med pa 'bul bar mos la maṇ+ḍal phul 'tshal/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: rdo rje 'dzin zhabs bka' drin gyis: deng bdag bla med bya ba thob: de phyir gsang ba'i dbang mchog 'dis: dad ldan rjes su gzung du gsol: lan gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis a nu lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i sgras: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro spyan drangs: yab kyi zhal du zhugs: thugs kar 'od du zhu: snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i gsang ba nas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas: slob ma he ru ka'i ngo bor gsal ba'i lce steng du phebs pa tsam gyis: slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig: ka pā la'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi: mkha' gsang las byung bla med bdud rtsi yis: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: rnam grol bde chen ye shes mchog thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ha ya grī ba ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya: gu h+ya ma hā sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: zhes brjod la spos btul/ rol mo 'khrol zhing slob ma la ye shes pa bstim/ byang sems bdud rtsi zhal du mid la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ a ho ma hā sid+dhi pha la su khaṃ: sngags kyi rjes gnang gud du sbas pa skabs 'dir sbyar bar gsungs so//

de ltar dbang mchog thob pa tsam gyis lus bdud rtsis gang: 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur par mos shig: des bla ma longs sku mkha' gsang gi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob: ngag sgrib dag: rang byin gyis brlab pa la dbang: dper na sa bon thebs pa dang mtshungs pas: ngag sngags rlung sbyang ba la dbang: sa dgu pa non: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub: 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro: zhes brjod/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa sher dbang ni/ gsum pa gsang ba sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig ma dang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bar mos la maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kye ho: khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis: deng bdag bla med bya ba thob: de phyir shes rab ye shes dbang: smin par bya phyir bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ rig ma'i tsaka li gtad la/ e ma ho: gzungs ma mchog 'di bsgrod pa'i lam: bsten 'os rgyal ba rnams kyis gzigs: 'khrul 'khor rim pa'i sbyor ba yis: bde ba mchog ni myong bar mdzod: sems dpa' nor bu pad+ma yis: rdo rje skyil krung ldan par blta: de ltar byin pa'i gzungs ma des kyang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas 'di skad gsung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ e ma bdag gi gsang ba'i mkha': bde chen mchog 'di yang dag ldan: gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa: de yi mdun du bdag gnas so: he ru ka dpal dgyes la sogs: bya ba gsang ba ji bzhin byed: rnal 'byor rgyal po khyod nyid ni: dkyil 'khor 'dir yang rtag zhugs mdzod: blo chen sred dang bral ba'i ngang: dga' bzhi'i ye shes mchog la reg: bhañdza mok+ṣa ho: zhes gsung zhing pang du byon par mos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang dpal rta mchog he ru ka dang rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum:

phung khams skye mched lha'i dkyil 'khor: rtsa 'khor lo lngar dpa' bo yab yum lnga dang: spyi bor o rgyan thod phreng yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa: yum gyi mkha' gsang āṃḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa: dbus kyi ze'u 'bru āṃḥgis mtshan pa: yab kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par dmigs shing: gnyis ka'i bug sgor phaṭa ser pos bkag par bsam la: yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas khyed rang gi lus la thim par mos shig: thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgo la bzhag cing ngag tu blud/ rol mo bsgrag /spos bsregs la/ oṃ shī shī shī he he he swā hā: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: rā ga yā mi: zhes dang*/ spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems kyi rgyun mgrin par bab pas dga' ba'i ye shes: snying gar bab pas mchog dga'i ye shes: lte bar bab pas dga' bral gyi ye shes: gsang bar bab pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos shig: slar ban+dha'i bdud rtsi mgor bzhag la/ e ma: thabs dang shes rab g.yo ba'i rang bzhin bde chen po: mchog gi de nyid yang dag mtshon phyir brtan par bzung: g.yo med gyis brten brtan pa'i rdo rje skyil krung las: sems ni nor bu'i nang du son par bltas te zhog: sa ma ya gu h+ya ma hā sid+dhi sarba dha thim a haṃ: des yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur par mos shig: de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: bla ma chos kyi sku he ru ka yab yum la shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: yid kyi sgrib pa dag: lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang: sa bcu pa non: phrin las dbang gi las 'grub: 'bras bu chos sku skye ba med pa thob par 'gyur ro//

zhes dang/ dbang 'di ma thob pa'i mi la zur tsam yang smra bar mi bya zhing phyag rgya bsten nas bde ba sbyong ba sogs rgyud las ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung bar bya dgos so: zhes brjod/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che la'ang bzhi/ ka dag phyag chen/ lhun grub thod rgal/ snang srid gzhi rdzogs rgyas 'debs/ po ti lung rig btags grol gyi dbang ngo*// dang po ni/ bzhi pa don dam rang byung ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du rang rang gi lus longs spyod la sogs pa 'bul bar mos la maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ ho: khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis: gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob: de ring rin chen bzhi pa'i dbang: slob dpon gyis ni bstsal du gsol: lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun gcig gis gcig ma reg par: lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par gyis shig: bla mas shel rdo me long bstan la/ 'o khyed rang rnams lus sog phon thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge zhog: ngag pi waṃ gi skad rgyun chad pa ltar wang nge zhog: sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig: ces bsgos la: dar gcig de ka'i ngang la bzhag bcug nas: de nas me long shel dang rdo rje thugs kar bzhag nas: kye hoḥskal ldan rigs kyi bu: chos rnams nam mkha' lta bu ste: nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med: rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid: khyed rang yang ni de yi pha: sems ni me long rdul bral la: snang ba gzugs 'char ci srid kyang: gzhi la gos med rtog pa bral: mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje ste: de nyid la ni ma yengs ltos: bltas tsam nyid nas gzhi rtsa bral: gzhi med rtsa bral e ma ho: rgyas par sems dang snang ba dbyings dang ye shes sogs kyi ngo sprad bya/ de nas rdzas de rnams mgor bzhag nas: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs kyis: tshig gi dbang mchog zab mo 'di:

brda rtags shel dkar me long dang: rdo rje bcas pa'i dbang bskur mchog: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: des don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku la: de kho na nyid rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che thob: yid kyi sgrib pa dag: rdzogs rim stong nyid bsgom pa la dbang: ston thog 'bras bu smin pa dang 'dra: ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro: gnyis pa lhun grub thod rgal ni/ de nas lhun grub rang gsal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ e ma ho: bla ma kun bzang dpal chen che ba'i mchog: ka dag dgongs pa mkha' klong 'khyil pa nas: 'khor 'das yongs grol chen po'i dbang mchog ni: mngon sum rtsal chen lhang nger bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams chos sku'i gzigs stangs seng chen gyi 'khrul 'khor dang ldan pas: nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sprin dang bral ba'i zur la: rang bzhin mngon sum sku dang thig le bkra shig ge gsal bar mthong bar mos shig: rdo rje sems dpa'i me long dang lu gu rgyud kyi brda rtags rma bya'i mdongs spyi bor bzhag la: bu kye: ltos shig ltos shig dbyings la ltos: yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i khung sbub pa: mngon sum chos kyi skur snang ba: ma yengs mdung tshugs de la gtod: snang la rang bzhin ma grub ste: ngo bo smra brjod mtha' dang bral: rang bzhin sgrib g.yogs bral bar snang: thugs rjes kun khyab lu gu rgyud: 'di ni gdod nas nyid la bzhugs: gzhan nas ma byung gzhir bzhag nyid: 'di mthong don chen skal bzang mchog: bu khyod deng nas 'bras bu brnyes: kun bzang rtsal rdzogs dbang chen thob: rtsol bral sgrib med ye sangs rgyas: dper na shel dang me long bzhin:

phan tshun mngon snang rang bzhin bral: chos kun rol pa'i cho 'phrul te: dper na rma bya'i mdongs phod 'dra: lu gu rgyud kyi mtshan nyid 'di: de don sems kyi phur du 'chang: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang lung rdzogs: zhes pas dbang bskur/ de'i brda don ngo sprod pa'ang thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ lu gu rgyud du gcer mthong bas: rnam rtog 'gyu ba'i dran pa 'gag: bya lam nam mkhar 'gro ba bzhin: chos kyi dbyings las 'gro sa med: gzhan med rig snang rnam dag las: 'khrul par snang ba'i rgyu rkyen zad: dbyings dang rig pa 'bral med pas: lu gu rgyud kyi 'phel snang ston: rig pa'i ngo bo lu gu rgyud: 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar las: sus kyang byas pa ma yin pa: des na 'dus ma byas pa nyid: lu gu rgyud kyi rang bzhin ni: rnam par rtog pa kun dag pas: ma 'khrul pa yi sangs rgyas so: zhes gsungs pa'i don thugs la nges par 'tshal/ des kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems gnyis med lhun grub rang gsal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du: bla ma sku bzhi yongs rdzogs kun bzang he ru ka'i sku la: bla med thod rgal rang rig rtsal gyi dbang thob: bsgrib bya sgrib byed dang dag bya dag byed kyi mtha' las 'das: bskyed rdzogs gnyis med kyi klong du dbang 'byor thob: 'bras bu bcud du smin nas rgyur mi ldog pa'i gding: dper na til 'bru mar khur btsir pa dang mtshungs shing: chos kyi sku bcos bslad dang bral ba ye gzhi'i steng du phebs pa'i sa bon thebs pa'o:

gsum pa snang srid gzhir rdzogs rgyas 'debs ni/ de nas snang srid gzhi rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rgyas 'debs kyi rtsal dbang gong ma zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kye hoḥrdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol: bdag ni tshe rabs las dang skal ldan phyir: ston pas rjes bzung smin grol sa la bkod: da ni srid gsum gdar sha chod pa yi: rgyas 'debs chen mo'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ bla mas snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i klong nas: sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol bar mos nas bzhengs: phyag tu rtog med rol pa'i cang te'u bsnams nas: slob ma rnams la rtogs pa sbar bar bya ste: de yang slob ma rnams chas rab tu phyung bar gsungs pa'i mtshon byed du gzan dang stod gos phud/ lus la thal chen byug: lag tu ḍā ma ru dang mi rkang gling bu gtad la: mdun du lang bcug la: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: khyed cag gsang sngags bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sgor bcug nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rjes su bzung: lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar byas te: 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs shing: lus kyi spyod lam rnam bzhi ci byas kyang: sku gsum du grol ba'i phyir: bya byed thams cad chos nyid kyi rol pa: ngag tu ca co ci smras kyang: smra bsam brjod bral du grol ba: ci smra thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra: sems kyi rtog tshogs thams cad chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi bsam gtan du grol bas: rang sems rtogs grol gdal ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur te: de ltar lus ngag yid gsum chos nyid kyi rol pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir: 'khor 'das bdag gzhan bzang ngan: dbang po rno rtul skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa thams cad: gnyis med rol pa 'ub chub: ka dag chos nyid mngon sum gyi rol pa chen po'i klong du grol bas:

da bskyar gzhi med: rgyu zad: rkyen zad: lam 'khrul pa zad pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i ming med pas bzang ngan blang dor gyi gdos thag chod de: srid pa gsum gyi gdar sha chod nas gda' bas: phaṭa gyis la snang ba thams cad thug 'phrad rang grol: rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bas: lus snang stong sgyu ma'i grong khyer dang 'dra ste rang yan la thongs: ngag grags stong brag ca'i ca co dang 'dra ste chad med du bor: yid gsal stong bar snang gi ri mo dang 'dra ste rang babs su zhog: ces bar dang bcas pas brjod la: bla mas sna drangs shing: dpon slob rnams rtog pa sna mi bskyil bar: lus gar stabs dang 'chong rgyug: 'khrab pa sogs ci bde dang dran tshad bya: ngag tu hūm̐ sgra dang phaṭa sgra gad rgyangs la sogs pa byung tshad du bsgrag: yid gang shar ltos med rtsis gdab thams cad dang bral bar rgya yan du btang la gang shar bskyang du gzhug cing: yang 'di ltar ngo sprad pa'i don legs par gsan 'tshal: de'ang thal 'gyur las: snang ba 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ni: ye shes yin par sngar ma mthong: rtog bcas 'khrul pa'i gzhi med pas: kun gzhi chos sku chen por rtogs: 'khrul pa'i rang rtog rgyun chad do: de ltar 'khrul med snang ba ni: ye nas grol ba'i gnad las byung: 'gro ba'i phung po sangs rgyas sku: ye nas yin par sus ma rig: phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag tu: rtsa gnas yi ge grub las byung: chu bur mig las ye shes ni: rang snang yin par sus ma mthong: de las 'khrul pa'i snang ba ni: sgron ma'i gnad las byung ba 'o: gzhan yang lus kyi spyod lam nyid: sku gsum dag tu grol ba'i phyir: bya byed thams cad chos nyid do: ngag tu ci ltar smras pa kun: gsang sngags gsang ba'i bzlas pa ste: yig 'bru rnam 'phrul gnad las byung: 'gro ba'i sems kyi rtog tshogs kun: bsam gtan yin pa ci la shes: rang sems rtog las grol bas na: de ni 'byung ba'i gnad las byung:

de ltar thams cad chos nyid las: bslab par bya ba gang med cing: bzhag par bya ba cung zad med: gang du'ang med pa'i chos nyid do: bya byed brjod dang bsam pa las: 'khor 'das grol ba'i gnad rtags te: sangs ma rgyas pa gcig kyang med: khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs so: gzhan yang khams gsum sems can rnams: lus ngag yid las ma 'das pas: sku gsum gzhan du btsal mi dgos: btsal kyang rnyed pa'i gnas med do: ma byung byung sa med pa la: bltas pas mthong ba ngo mtshar che: ngo mtshar chen po'i rol pa ni: sangs rgyas sems can 'byed pa med: nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du: rang byung rang la rdzogs pas zhi: chos nyid mngon sum khyad par gyi: dbang po rno dang rtul med pas: sems can thams cad sangs rgyas las: gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no: lus can sems kyis khyab pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas ma yin sems can min: sa bon las ni 'bras bu bzhin: rang gi rang bzhin gshis kyi gnad: brjod pa tshig gis ma yin pa: dbang po'i yul la gsal snang bas: gcer mthong grol ba'i bdag nyid do: gzhan yang rkyen gyi sems can rnams: sangs ma rgyas pa gcig kyang med: rang snang ye shes chos mthun phyir: 'khor ba ye nas yod ma yin: de phyir rang rang sangs rgyas so: skye ba nyid ni rtogs pa la: mngal du gnas pa chos kyi dbyings: lus sems 'dus pa dbyings rig 'brel: lus su snang ba sku gsum ste: rgas pas chos zad 'khrul snang 'gag: na bas chos rnams nyams su myong: shi bas stong pa ngos bzung med: des na sems can sangs rgyas so: de yang chos nyid mngon sum gnad: mthong ba tsam gyis shes pa dang: de shes pa yi rtogs pa dang: rtogs pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur: grol zhes bkrol ba ma yin te: nam mkha' nyid ni nam mkha' la: thim nas rang bzhin dmigs med pa: ris med cha shas yod ma yin: mngon sum rnyed pa'i gang zag la: khams gsum 'khor ba'i ming med pas: srid gsum gdar sha chod pa 'o:

zhes gsungs pa ltar deng phyin chad ngo rang thog tu 'phrod: thag gcig thog tu bcad: gding grol thog tu 'cha' dgos pa yin no: des ni ka dag ye grol chen po'i klong du: bla mas mngon sum mthong grol gyi dkyil 'khor du 'khor 'das gnyis med khyab brdal gyi dbang bskur pas: sgrib pa ye dag: 'bras bu yongs rdzogs: spyi rdol chen po'i tha snyad kyi chos thams cad ming gi brjod bya tsam las: mngon sum rang snang chos nyid du mthong bas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sku mi snang ba chen por 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro: bzhi pa po ti btags grol dbang ni/ de nas pusti lung gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ btags grol dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ kye hoḥbla ma rdo rje 'dzin: ye thog dang po'i bstan pa mgon: kun bzang dgongs pa bka' yi dbang: deng 'dir bdag la bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ slob ma'i mgo la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bkon/ lag tu rdor dril gtad/ khar myong grol sbyin/ btags grol gyi glegs bam dar sna lngas lcibs la bla mas snying gar bzhag la/ e ma ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi: dgongs pa bla na med pa'i don: ma gsung gsungs pa med pa'i chos: yang zhun gser gyi snying po nyid: gdul bya 'dul phyir po ti'i tshul: mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan: rang grol chen por dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bud+dha sarba pu tra e ka gu h+ya sbu ri sa man ta a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: zhes pas dbang bskur: btags grol tshar gcig bklag nas: 'o 'di'i tshig kha ton du brjod: don yid la gyis: glegs bam yid la chongs shig: ces bsgo/ 'dir lugs 'di'i btags grol gyi glegs bam mi 'dzom pa'am rgyas pa klog mi nus na/ yab yum dgongs pa/ zhen zlog nyer lnga/ bo dhi tsit+ta/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal ye dhar tsam brjod kyang don tshang ngo*//

de'ang gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'khor 'das rang grol las: yang yang 'di nyid dri tshor reg: bskal par bsags pa'i sdig pa dag: dge ba ci byas 'bum 'gyur 'phel: phyi dang nang gi bar chad zhi: gang gnas sa phyogs yul phyogs su: mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod par 'bul: dngos grub ster zhing ma ltar brtse: 'di nyid khyad par lnga yis 'phags: tha mal rnams kyi spyod yul min: ces dang: btags grol gyi rgyud las: 'di 'dzin rnal 'byor skal che bas: lan gsum 'di yi tshig kun yang: lhag dang chad pa med par ni: rdo rje'i lce yi sus brjod pa: 'di yang de dang mnyam par yang: 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med: ces dang: sems can kun gyi bsam pa dang: sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa ni: ji ltar mthun pa'i chos kun ni: 'di yis ston par nus pa yin: sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dang gcig: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgongs pa dang: dbyer mi phyed par 'dis 'gyur ro: de phyir bstan pa'i me ro yin: ces dang: dus gnad du: rang byung chen po'i yi ge rnams: rin chen gser gyis bris nas ni: glegs bam sor ni bzhi yi tshad: sna tshogs dar gyis dril nas ni: rang gi spyi bor bzung na yang: 'di la sprul pa'i yon tan thob: ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir: ji skad bshad pa lag tu blangs te: ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'chang ba dang: klog pa dang: nam 'chi ba'i tshe phung po dang ma bral bar bsreg pa la sogs pa lag len du thebs par bya ba gal che'o: de ni nges par lung bstan pa glegs bam btags grol la brten nas: bstan pa rang bab kyi pod dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob par gyur pa yin no: de ltar tshig dbang rin po che las phye ba'i dbang bskur bzhi po thob pas: lus ngag yid gsum shes sgrib dang bcas pa dag: nus pa sgo gsum la 'byung: dam tshig bsrung nyams dang bral bas spang blang dbye ba med: sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od non: phrin las bzhi ka lhun gyis grub:

rgyal bu rgyal sar bton pa ltar phyir mi ldog cing: 'bras bu sku lngas 'gro don byed par 'gyur ba yin no: de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams kyi mgo la rdo rje bzhag /lce la mna' chu blud la/ deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyi: ji srid lus srog zhig gyur kyang: bdag gis bsgos pa'i bka' bzhin du: cha shas tsam yang ma nyams srungs: khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag spyi dang khyad par gyis bsdus pa mtha' dag srog bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: lan gsum/ dbang bskur zab mo yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ khyad par sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa gus pas 'bul bar bgyi na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas bzung ste khyod bran du: bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bya: thugs rjes rjes su bzung nas kyang: cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar na rim pa de dag rnams kyis yi dam dgongs pa 'dus pa'i spyi sdom rtsa ba'i dbang bskur legs par grub pa yin pas dge rtsa byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ 'di'i sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas pa bsgrub par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs smon lam ci rigs btab la slob ma rnams gyes so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs lhag byin gyis brlab cing lhag ma btang*/ chad brtan rta bro/ mchod bstod dngos grub blang zhing*/ nongs bshags/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi ltar rgyas par byas pas grub bo// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun 'dus shing*// bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen phrin las kha tshar bcas// zab cing rgya che ngo mtshar 'byams klas pa// gang 'dir 'jug 'dod rnams la skyes su sbyin// nongs pa rtsa gsum thugs rjes bzod bzhes la/

dbang chen rol pa'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag gzhan sgo gsum dbyer med gcig bsdoms nas// ye shes gar gyis 'khor 'das dbang sgyur shog /'di nyid kyi smin byed rgyas pa spros bcas lha dbang chen mo rgya che zhing*/ bsdus pa phur dbang thugs kyi snying po bka' rgya che bas/ 'bring po rtsa dbang 'di nyid don 'thus la stabs bde ba'i slad chos 'dir mos pa'i don gnyer can la phan pa'i bsam pas/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis dpal spungs dbyar gnas khang bshad sgrub rtag brtan dar rgyas gling du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
